cruacRites.summary: Seals marked doors and windows as durable solid barriers; target successes are 7 + Potency.
cruacRites.source: Agony & Ecstasy: Circle of the Crone
cruacRites.effect: Smear the sacrifice across a number of entrances equal to the declared Potency. Their Durability increases by Crúac and they seal like walls, though the ritualist and those she touched while casting can pass. Covering every entrance extends the Durability to walls. At Crúac ••• with one more success, supernatural entry such as teleportation or intangibility requires a Clash of Wills.

cruacRites.name: Painted Fears
cruacRites.summary: Creates art that inflicts Spooked toward its depicted subject.
cruacRites.source: Agony & Ecstasy: Circle of the Crone
cruacRites.effect: Create visual art with an obvious subject. Once per night, any viewer, including the creator, gains Spooked toward the depicted subject until it resolves; no one can be made to fear themselves. At Crúac ••• with one more success, Resolve + Composure − Potency must succeed or the viewer gains Frightened instead.

cruacRites.name: Path of Thorns
cruacRites.summary: Surrounds the ritualist with invisible brambles that inflict lethal damage when triggered.
cruacRites.source: Agony & Ecstasy: Circle of the Crone
cruacRites.effect: Seed the ground with blood, then trigger invisible brambles in a Potency-meter radius. Anyone moving through suffers lethal damage equal to Crúac per turn unless armor fully covers the skin. The caster is rooted and loses Defense but may reflexively end the effect. At Crúac •••• with two more successes, damage becomes aggravated and ending early requires Strength + Stamina.

cruacRites.name: Rivers Run Dry
cruacRites.summary: Curses a large house-sized area so water escapes, evaporates, or refuses storage.
cruacRites.source: Agony & Ecstasy: Circle of the Crone
cruacRites.effect: Circle an area the size of a large house with blood and remnants from arid flora and fauna. Water cannot reliably enter or remain: it flows backward, spills from containers, or evaporates, generally in conspicuous ways.

cruacRites.name: Succulent Buboes
cruacRites.summary: Temporarily increases a subject's Vitae capacity, with grotesque physical signs.
cruacRites.source: Agony & Ecstasy: Circle of the Crone
cruacRites.effect: Mark a subject's lymph nodes. Their Vitae capacity rises by Crúac + 1, but each Vitae above the normal maximum creates a visible bloody pustule. At Crúac ••••, non-Kindred subjects may spend one stored Vitae per turn on Physical Intensity.

cruacRites.name: Bleeding the Tarantula
cruacRites.summary: Grows a protective spider homunculus from the sleeping ritualist's flesh.
cruacRites.source: Agony & Ecstasy: Circle of the Crone
cruacRites.effect: Carve a spider on the ritualist's arm before daysleep, creating a Size 4 Retainer with rating equal to Crúac, specialized in stealth and guarding her body. Distribute Potency among web Durability, fang weapon rating up to +5, closer blood sympathy, and an immobilizing web attack. Its protective web falls away when she wakes, and blood sympathy may wake her if the spider is destroyed.

cruacRites.name: Mantle of the Mother's Army
cruacRites.summary: Synchronizes a ritual war party so participants can reflexively assist each other's actions; add one target success per participant.
cruacRites.source: Agony & Ecstasy: Circle of the Crone
cruacRites.effect: The ritualist and participants physically exert themselves and each spend Willpower. Once per turn in combat, each participant may reflexively assist another's instant action using teamwork even when such assistance would normally be unreasonable. At Crúac •••• with one more success, the Acolyte may replace an ally's pool with her own dice and grant 9-again instead.

cruacRites.name: Soul Wisdom
cruacRites.summary: Stores Willpower in a work of art and grants the ritualist future insight through it.
cruacRites.source: Agony & Ecstasy: Circle of the Crone
cruacRites.effect: Create an artwork holding the ritualist's Willpower up to Potency. Touching it transfers one stored point back. Once per scene after studying it for a few minutes, spend a stored point remotely to reroll an action without the +3 bonus and keep the second result. The piece cracks when empty, counts as part of the creator for supernatural scrutiny, and only one may exist. At Crúac ••••• with two more successes, it may be refilled and similar pieces made for others.

cruacRites.name: Spirit's Gambol
cruacRites.summary: Invites an ephemeral being into the ritualist so it can aid the Beast during frenzy.
cruacRites.source: Agony & Ecstasy: Circle of the Crone
cruacRites.effect: Paint symbols inviting one spirit type. A nearby spirit may Fetter itself to the Acolyte and possess her whenever she frenzies, bypassing the normal restriction against controlling a frenzying Beast. It is encouraged to protect her but may pursue its own nature, granting her a Beat when it does. Using ephemeral rules, it gains Fetter and imposes Possession during frenzy; helping the Beast or protecting her restores one Essence.

cruacRites.name: Suborn the Outer Realms
cruacRites.summary: Creates a lasting protective charm that binds aid from an ephemeral realm.
cruacRites.source: Agony & Ecstasy: Circle of the Crone
cruacRites.effect: Place a protective charm over a mural in a Safe Place or other Merit-defined location. An alien being entering from another realm or Twilight contests with Resistance + Rank or Resolve + Supernatural Tolerance, penalized by Potency. Failure imposes Dominated, requiring the simple achievable action depicted in the mural, with no memory erasure.

cruacRites.name: Blood Mask
cruacRites.summary: Transforms the ritualist into the likeness of a bitten victim for several nights.
cruacRites.source: Agony & Ecstasy: Circle of the Crone
cruacRites.effect: Mark a reflection with the target's image or name. The first bite and drink that night yields no Vitae but transforms the ritualist into the target, granting Potency as bonus dice to impersonate them. Clothing, powers, and traits do not change; animal features may function externally. At Crúac ••••• with one more success, draining the target dry makes the form indefinite and may replace the vampire's Physical Attributes and Skills for the duration.

cruacRites.name: Brigid's Sacrifice
cruacRites.summary: Drains Skills from a fed-upon victim in place of Vitae and lends them to the ritualist.
cruacRites.source: Agony & Ecstasy: Circle of the Crone
cruacRites.effect: Enchant an obsidian blade, sacrifice a sapient being that night at the cost of one Humanity dot (still gaining a Beat), and harmlessly stab a living subject's heart. Removing the blade heals all damage, removes diseases, toxins, negative Tilts and Conditions including persistent ones, restores all Willpower, and makes one Potency-bonus Clash against every harmful supernatural power, removing each one defeated.

cruacRites.name: Fount of Ma'at
cruacRites.summary: Creates a source of divinatory truth and judgment through consecrated blood.
cruacRites.source: Agony & Ecstasy: Circle of the Crone
cruacRites.effect: Fill a bowl with blood and identify a victim. Feeding from them that night may drain up to one Skill dot per Potency instead of the same amount of Vitae. The ritualist chooses Skills before learning their ratings and may use the stolen ratings and Specialties instead of, never in addition to, her own; the victim loses them for the duration.

cruacRites.name: Childe of Dis
cruacRites.summary: Prepares the eyes of a crow or rat so its shadow serves as a Potency 1 Strix with Owl Eyes while the ritualist carries them.
cruacRites.source: Agony & Ecstasy: Circle of the Crone
cruacRites.duration: One month or until the rite is repeated or the pouch is lost
cruacRites.effect: Prepare a crow's or rat's eyes in a carried leather pouch. Its shadow serves as a Shadow Potency 1 Strix with Owl Eyes (or Enhanced Senses), fueled only by Vitae the vampire supplies. It obeys the spirit of commands but will not directly oppose true Strix and may scheme independently. It may be retained indefinitely as the three-dot Servant of Dis Merit. At Crúac ••••• with two more successes, create one for another character.

cruacRites.name: Idol of False Life
cruacRites.summary: Builds a grisly false life that can act as a supernatural servant.
cruacRites.source: Agony & Ecstasy: Circle of the Crone
cruacRites.effect: Use both parties' blood to bind a present subject to an organic idol. Unpowered equipment placed on the idol affects the subject as though worn or wielded, but each Structure lost by the idol inflicts the same aggravated damage on the subject, ignoring armor and Resilience. A character may have only one idol and cannot normally break the bond early.

cruacRites.name: Bounty of the False God
cruacRites.summary: Calls down a false god's bounty with powerful benefits and dangerous consequences.
cruacRites.source: Agony & Ecstasy: Circle of the Crone
cruacRites.effect: Coat an emblem of a favored goddess in blood. In the presence of an active Theban miracle, brandish it and Clash with the Theban Sorcerer using Potency as a bonus. Victory ends the miracle and empowers the next rite cast this chapter or the next with rote, doubled range, and duration as though cast on a subject with a third-stage Vinculum toward the Acolyte.

cruacRites.name: Gift of Guabancex
cruacRites.summary: Survives a storm-god's lightning strike to gain a separate pool of ritual Vitae.
cruacRites.source: Agony & Ecstasy: Circle of the Crone
cruacRites.duration: Until the sorcerous Vitae is spent
cruacRites.effect: During extreme weather, invoke a storm or chaos deity and take eight unavoidable bashing damage from lightning. If the ritualist survives, gain a separate Vitae pool equal to Potency that ignores normal capacity but may only awaken the vampire, activate Disciplines, or fuel Physical Intensity. The rite cannot be repeated until the pool is empty.

cruacRites.name: Curse of the Circle
cruacRites.summary: Lets multiple Acolytes combine disparate powers into a lasting curse on a sympathetic victim.
cruacRites.source: Agony & Ecstasy: Circle of the Crone
cruacRites.duration: Until restitution, or every contributor enters torpor or Final Death
cruacRites.effect: Build a token from a sympathetic link to the victim and one blood point from each wronged Acolyte. Success creates one-way blood sympathy from every contributor with a pool equal to their number. Once per scene, a contributor may use it without Willpower to curse the victim's next important action by −1 per success, making failure dramatic, or treat successes as Status solely to block the victim's Social Merits.

cruacRites.name: Walk the Depths
cruacRites.summary: Carries the ritualist and companions instantly between two untouched, dark places.
cruacRites.source: Agony & Ecstasy: Circle of the Crone
cruacRites.effect: Target a dark place untouched by mortals since the last new moon. The caster and everyone touching him may step through shadow to any other mundane place meeting those conditions. Once that night, each traveler may reflexively enter any shadow and return to the origin.

cruacRites.name: Your Goddess Listens
cruacRites.summary: Marks a city with the ritualist's divine name, allowing her to hear prayers and answer one remotely with a Discipline.
cruacRites.source: Agony & Ecstasy: Circle of the Crone
cruacRites.effect: Mark a city with Vitae sigils that supernatural living beings recognize as the Witch's name and a prayer. She hears any prayer using them and gains a link to the supplicant. During that night, she may activate one Discipline effect, including a blood-sorcery ritual, against the supplicant as though present, touching them, or meeting their gaze.

cruacRites.name: Mantle of Amorous Fire — Errata
cruacRites.summary: Grants the temporary Vice Amorous instead of a Presence bonus and removes the Willpower cost.
cruacRites.source: Agony & Ecstasy: Circle of the Crone
cruacRites.effect: Replace the original rite's Presence bonus with the temporary Vice Amorous and remove its Willpower cost. Other Mantle rites retain their normal costs.

cruacRites.name: Pangs of Proserpina — Errata
cruacRites.summary: May be prepared and applied to the victim later that night; the effect lasts one scene.
cruacRites.source: Agony & Ecstasy: Circle of the Crone
cruacRites.effect: The rite may be cast in advance and applied to its victim at any time before night's end. Once applied, its effect lasts one scene.

cruacRites.name: Pool of Forbidden Truths — Errata
cruacRites.summary: Potency sets the number of questions; the Storyteller defines the vision's subject and questions must address it.
cruacRites.source: Agony & Ecstasy: Circle of the Crone
cruacRites.effect: Potency, rather than successes, determines how many questions may be asked. The Storyteller chooses the vision's subject, and every question must concern that topic.

thebanMiracles.name: Confession
thebanMiracles.summary: A 3-dot Gethsemani Theban Miracle of holy terror and supernatural stigmata.
thebanMiracles.sacrament: A physical likeness of the victim, such as a photograph or artistic rendering
thebanMiracles.effect: A victim within one mile loudly proclaims what they consider their sins for turns equal to the ritualist's Theban Sorcery dots. The victim cannot stop confessing, though they may flee from witnesses or otherwise limit who hears them.

thebanMiracles.name: Crown of Thorns
thebanMiracles.summary: A Gethsemani Theban Miracle of holy terror and supernatural stigmata.
thebanMiracles.sacrament: A sprig of thorns, swallowed by the ritualist
thebanMiracles.effect: A victim within one mile takes one bashing damage as a ring of bony thorns erupts from their skull. While the thorns remain, the victim suffers a penalty equal to Potency on Social actions, and many mundane interactions may be impossible. After a scene the thorns recede, leaving gruesome scars for nights equal to the ritualist's Theban Sorcery dots; pious or superstitious witnesses react unfavorably.

thebanMiracles.name: Holy Visions
thebanMiracles.summary: A 2-dot Gethsemani Theban Miracle of holy terror and supernatural stigmata.
thebanMiracles.sacrament: A mirror smeared with the victim's blood
thebanMiracles.effect: After preparing the miracle, the vampire activates it by touching the intended victim before night's end. The victim suffers the Insensate Tilt for turns equal to the ritualist's Theban Sorcery dots while experiencing a rapturous vision around a simple theme chosen by the ritualist. When it ends, the victim gains Inspired regarding that theme.

thebanMiracles.name: Rain of Blood
thebanMiracles.summary: A Gethsemani Theban Miracle of holy terror and supernatural stigmata.
thebanMiracles.sacrament: A single ruby of any size or cut
thebanMiracles.effect: A storm of corrosive blood fills a radius of up to 40 meters and imposes the Heavy Rain Tilt. Allies anointed with the sign of the cross before casting are immune. Anyone else exposed takes one lethal damage each turn; only full cover prevents it. Mortals reflexively roll Stamina + Composure or suffer the moderate Sick Tilt until they escape. The rain may provoke hunger frenzy but cannot be consumed as Vitae. The ritualist may end the miracle early with an instant action.

thebanMiracles.name: Stigmatic Feast
thebanMiracles.summary: A Gethsemani Theban Miracle of holy terror and supernatural stigmata.
thebanMiracles.sacrament: A crown of thorns woven by the ritualist and placed on the subject's head
thebanMiracles.effect: A present subject suffers stigmatic wounds for turns equal to Potency, bleeding one Vitae per turn; mortal subjects also take lethal damage from blood loss. Anyone who consumes Vitae shed this way gains one dot in a chosen Physical Attribute, including corresponding derived traits, until sunrise. If the Attribute would exceed the cap from Blood Potency, the drinker instead gains one Willpower. Kindred blood still risks Vitae addiction and the Vinculum.

thebanMiracles.name: Trials of Job
thebanMiracles.summary: Lay a sequence of escalating biblical trials upon the subject.
thebanMiracles.sacrament: Horn of an ox or sheep
thebanMiracles.effect: Every failure on the victim's non-reflexive mundane actions becomes dramatic. The Storyteller also removes Potency total dots from Allies, Contacts, Feeding Ground, Haven, Herd, Mentor, Resources, Retainer, Safe Place, Staff, Status, or Touchstone and detaches unpurchased Touchstones. Successful frenzy resistance, breaking points, or riding the wave inflict moderate Sick for the miracle's duration. If the victim neither frenzies nor fails a breaking point before it ends, her next successful Social action involving the Lancea et Sanctum is exceptional.

thebanMiracles.name: Apparition of the Host
thebanMiracles.summary: Bless a switch that terrorizes a victim with angelic phantasms.
thebanMiracles.duration: The switch remains blessed for one month
thebanMiracles.effect: When snapped, the target gains Frightened, or Spooked if mortal; spending Willpower can make the apparition visible only to the victim.

thebanMiracles.name: Apple of Eden
thebanMiracles.summary: Infuse a fruit that expands a human's intellect and supernatural perception.
thebanMiracles.effect: A human eater suffers a breaking point, distributes dots equal to Theban Sorcery between Intelligence and Wits, and safely perceives supernatural beings for days; the benefit can be made permanent with Experience.

thebanMiracles.name: Marian Apparition
thebanMiracles.summary: Bless cloth that reveals a shaming holy apparition when torn.
thebanMiracles.sacrament: White cloth stained with menstrual blood
thebanMiracles.effect: All witnesses see the apparition. Kindred who lose the contest add the caster's Theban Sorcery to Humanity for detachment, while Crúac cast beneath it gains the same bonus.

thebanMiracles.name: Revelatory Shroud
thebanMiracles.summary: Reveal the face of the last person to touch an object or pass through an area.
thebanMiracles.effect: Cover the subject with the blessed shroud to display the face of the last person who touched the object or crossed the covered place.

thebanMiracles.name: Aaron’s Rod
thebanMiracles.summary: Bless a rod that becomes a venomous serpent when cast down.
thebanMiracles.effect: The serpent obeys its wielder or instructions set during the blessing; its venom destroys Vitae or deals lethal damage with Toxicity equal to Blood Potency.

thebanMiracles.name: Blessing the Legion
thebanMiracles.summary: Store Vitae in blessed armor so a crusader can heal beyond normal per-turn limits.
thebanMiracles.effect: The caster or wearer stores Vitae up to Theban Sorcery in the armor. While worn, it spends one stored Vitae per turn to heal without counting against the wearer's Vitae-per-turn limit; extra successes bless additional suits.

thebanMiracles.name: Bloody Icon
thebanMiracles.summary: Sacrifice Humanity so a holy icon weeps Vitae.
thebanMiracles.requirement: Detach from Humanity during a religious reverie
thebanMiracles.duration: Until the stored Vitae is consumed
thebanMiracles.effect: The statue produces Vitae equal to casting successes, which causes neither blood addiction nor Vinculum, then crumbles when emptied.

thebanMiracles.name: The Walls of Jericho
thebanMiracles.summary: Bless a horn to break barriers between the bearer and a named Kindred.
thebanMiracles.effect: Blowing the horn removes Structure from intervening barriers per success; living obstacles suffer bashing damage.

thebanMiracles.name: Great Prophecy
thebanMiracles.summary: Declare a group's fate within the next month and the means to escape it.
thebanMiracles.duration: One month or until fulfilled or averted
thebanMiracles.effect: A positive prophecy grants temporary Merits up to Theban Sorcery; a negative one can destroy Merits up to casting successes but cannot directly cause Final Death.

thebanMiracles.name: Miracle of the Dead Sun
thebanMiracles.summary: Destroy blessed jewelry and sacrifice Humanity to turn day into rainy night.
thebanMiracles.duration: Ten minutes per remaining Humanity dot
thebanMiracles.effect: The domain becomes a sunless storm in which vampires function as at night and may awaken normally.

thebanMiracles.name: Pledge to the Worthless One
thebanMiracles.summary: Swear to Belial for feeding power, frenzy's strength, and a demonic familiar.
thebanMiracles.effect: Choose a deadly sin: active sinners provide twice normal Vitae and innocents half; gain frenzy bonuses, lose Touchstone benefits, bear a mark, and receive a Retainer ••••• familiar with three Disciplines.

thebanMiracles.name: The Guiding Star
thebanMiracles.summary: Bless coins that guide bearers to a hidden refuge and blood bounty.
thebanMiracles.sacrament: A star chart and gold coins
thebanMiracles.duration: One night per coin, extendable with Willpower
thebanMiracles.effect: A bearer follows the stars to a concealed Safe Place, Haven, and Feeding Ground equivalent to five dots, then forgets its location on leaving.

thebanMiracles.name: Apocalypse
thebanMiracles.summary: Reveal signs of supernatural beings' true nature across a wide area.
thebanMiracles.effect: Within a half-mile area per five successes beyond the first ten, supernatural natures become evident and Obfuscate or comparable illusions fail or Clash with the miracle.

thebanMiracles.name: The Judgment Fast
thebanMiracles.summary: Curse a domain so vampires cannot sustain Vitae above Humanity.
thebanMiracles.effect: Vitae above a vampire's Humanity can neither be stored nor used and is vomited out as worthless blood.

thebanMiracles.name: Curse of Isolation
thebanMiracles.summary: Sever a vampire from a present Touchstone and temporarily steal that bond.
thebanMiracles.duration: Seven nights unless the Touchstone Merit is purchased
thebanMiracles.effect: The subject must be present and be another vampire's Touchstone. Success severs that relationship with all normal consequences and makes the subject the ritualist's Touchstone at her current Humanity. The original vampire must rebuild the relationship from the beginning after the effect ends.

thebanMiracles.name: Orison of Voices
thebanMiracles.summary: For three nights, hear speech anywhere that invokes your name.
thebanMiracles.effect: Whenever any voice anywhere speaks the ritualist's name, she hears it along with enough surrounding context to understand the speaker's intent.

thebanMiracles.name: Sins of the Ancestors
thebanMiracles.sacrament: A quantity of the victim's blood
thebanMiracles.summary: Ask simple questions about members of the victim's blood lineage.
thebanMiracles.effect: Consecrate the subject's blood and ask simple questions equal to Potency about close blood relatives. For Kindred this includes vampires once or twice removed by blood sympathy and the direct sire/childe line; for mortals, relatives up to two degrees removed and the direct parent/child line. Direct mortal descendants of Kindred also count. Each answer must fit one short sentence; complex questions may consume several questions or be rejected.

thebanMiracles.name: Blandishment of Sin
thebanMiracles.summary: Upgrade the next bashing damage a distant victim suffers.
thebanMiracles.effect: The next bashing damage from one attack becomes lethal. A separate four-dot version with 8 target successes upgrades lethal to aggravated.

thebanMiracles.name: Blood Scourge
thebanMiracles.summary: Create a temporary whip of Vitae.
thebanMiracles.sacrament: At least 1 Vitae of the ritualist's own blood
thebanMiracles.duration: Until sunrise; created whip lasts until scene end
thebanMiracles.effect: Create a 2L Vitae whip at any point before sunrise.

thebanMiracles.name: Curse of Babel
thebanMiracles.summary: Prevent a victim from speaking or writing.
thebanMiracles.effect: A victim within one mile cannot speak or write.

thebanMiracles.name: Liar's Plague
thebanMiracles.summary: Punish a present victim for telling falsehoods.
thebanMiracles.effect: If the victim lies during the next scene, beetles swarm from the victim's mouth.

thebanMiracles.name: Vitae Reliquary
thebanMiracles.summary: Store Vitae in a sacramental object.
thebanMiracles.effect: Transfer up to ritual Potency Vitae into the object. Vampires, Strix, or ghouls can later retrieve it; normal bond/addiction risks apply.

thebanMiracles.name: Gift of Lazarus
thebanMiracles.summary: Animate a human corpse as a servant.
thebanMiracles.sacrament: A communion wafer under the corpse's tongue
thebanMiracles.effect: Raise a corpse retaining its former Skills but no Willpower; age of corpse degrades Attributes. It is destroyed by enough aggravated damage or when the miracle expires.

thebanMiracles.name: Malediction of Despair
thebanMiracles.summary: Curse one specified future action.
thebanMiracles.sacrament: A lock of the victim's hair
thebanMiracles.duration: Until triggered or one lunar month
thebanMiracles.effect: The next time the victim performs the specified action, suffer –5 dice once.

thebanMiracles.name: Stigmata
thebanMiracles.summary: Inflict miraculous bleeding wounds.
thebanMiracles.effect: Mortals take one lethal per turn; vampires and ghouls lose one Vitae per turn, then take lethal if a vampire reaches zero Vitae.

thebanMiracles.name: Transubstantiation
thebanMiracles.summary: Transform one present substance, creature, or person into another form.
thebanMiracles.effect: Transform a subject no larger than the ritualist without creating intelligence or directly healing/harming it; existing injuries remain and the change reverses at sunrise.

kimiyaFormulae.name: Al-Ajsad
kimiyaFormulae.summary: Give undead life to a homunculus servant.
kimiyaFormulae.cost: 1 Vitae plus blood from two lethal wounds
kimiyaFormulae.effect: Mix the Alchemist's sacrificed blood with corpse parts, mercury, and sulfur to create a loyal homunculus. It speaks simply and reads any language its creator can. It survives indefinitely but needs one Vitae each night to remain active; extra Vitae heals it as though its wounds were the Alchemist's. It dissolves if its final Health box fills or it is not fed by sunrise.

kimiyaFormulae.name: Sayih's Khol
kimiyaFormulae.summary: Protect a subject from underwater conditions for a night.
kimiyaFormulae.cost: 1 Vitae plus blood from one lethal wound
kimiyaFormulae.requirement: The subject must be present while bloody words of power are inscribed on their eyelids.
kimiyaFormulae.effect: The subject cannot be harmed or impeded by currents, pressure, or waves in the ocean or another body of water. Living subjects can breathe underwater.

kimiyaFormulae.name: Spider's Hijra
kimiyaFormulae.summary: Weave a web of Vitae that penalizes others' Physical actions for a night.
kimiyaFormulae.cost: 1 Vitae plus blood from one lethal wound
kimiyaFormulae.effect: Spin the Alchemist's Vitae into webs across a radius of Potency × 10 meters. Everyone but the Alchemist suffers a penalty of half Blood Potency, rounded up, to Initiative, Defense, Speed, and Physical pools. A dramatic failure in the area causes Immobilized. The webs' Durability equals the penalty.

kimiyaFormulae.name: Curse of the Monkey Prince
kimiyaFormulae.summary: Curse a subject to transform painfully into an animal if they commit a declared transgression.
kimiyaFormulae.cost: 1 Vitae plus blood from four lethal wounds
kimiyaFormulae.effect: Mix the victim's blood with reagents, drink it, and name one discrete act the Alchemist sincerely considers an injustice. If the victim commits it before sunrise, he becomes a prey animal of Size 1–6 and takes 6 − Stamina bashing damage. He uses the animal's Physical traits, Skills, Speed, Defense, Health, movement, and senses. Other shapeshifting provokes a Clash; victory breaks the curse.

kimiyaFormulae.name: Ebony Horse
kimiyaFormulae.summary: Animate an object up to Size 7 as a flying vehicle for a night.
kimiyaFormulae.cost: 1 Vitae plus blood from three lethal wounds
kimiyaFormulae.effect: Bloody runes awaken an inanimate object up to Size 7. It moves and flies at Speed equal to Potency × 2, carries passengers, obeys commands, and can navigate to any earthly location its creator knows how to find. The Alchemist may close his eyes and take an instant action to see through it, losing Defense while doing so.

therionSacrileges.name: Avatar of Apollyon
therionSacrileges.summary: Become the bane of a chosen angelic or demonic quarry for up to a scene.
therionSacrileges.duration: One scene or until the vampire destroys a Grigor
therionSacrileges.effect: The vampire's fangs become a bane to the type of Grigor whose substance powered the ritual. While such beings remain in Twilight, she can affect them physically but their attacks pass through her.

therionSacrileges.name: Curse the Faithful
therionSacrileges.summary: Replace a mortal witness's Virtue with an additional compulsive Vice.
therionSacrileges.effect: Name a mortal who witnessed the Chorist feed from a Grigor during the last chapter. Replace the mortal's Virtue with a Vice chosen by the Chorist. On any night the victim fails to regain Willpower through a Vice, he gains Guilty.

therionSacrileges.name: Demon's Tongue
therionSacrileges.summary: Gain 8-again to Subterfuge and contest supernatural truth powers for the night.
therionSacrileges.effect: Gain 8-again on Subterfuge rolls, including activation rolls for Disciplines and Devotions. Supernatural effects that compel truth or detect lies provoke a Clash of Wills.

therionSacrileges.name: Profanity
therionSacrileges.summary: Sense and desecrate sacred places, weakening alien powers and strengthening Chorists.
therionSacrileges.duration: Sense until sunrise; desecration until chapter end
therionSacrileges.effect: Sense the nearest sacred or supernatural place of power and, when applicable, which perceived Grigor type it aligns with. Baptizing it in sacrificial blood imposes −5 on non-vampiric supernatural powers there, grants Chorists 8-again on Discipline and Devotion rolls, gives mortals Wanton, and prevents them regaining Willpower through Virtue.

therionSacrileges.name: The Morning Star
therionSacrileges.summary: Add Therion to the Predatory Aura for the night and assume a dark angelic aspect.
therionSacrileges.effect: Take on a sinister angelic aspect and add Therion dots to Predatory Aura rolls. An exceptional success also inflicts Beaten Down.

therionSacrileges.name: Apotheosis
therionSacrileges.summary: Become a vampiric angel wielding the Influences and Numina of consumed divinities.
therionSacrileges.duration: One scene or until Vitae is exhausted
therionSacrileges.effect: Transform into a vampire-angel and use the Influences and Numina of Grigori consumed to fuel the rite, spending Vitae instead of their costs and using half Blood Potency, rounded up, for Rank. Power equals Intelligence + Strength + Presence; Finesse equals Wits + Dexterity + Manipulation; Resistance equals Resolve + Stamina + Composure. Recalculate derived traits from those Attributes while retaining vampiric powers and weaknesses. Each Grigor destroyed adds one to one Attribute and contributes its powers for the duration.

therionSacrileges.name: Nine Choirs Bend the Knee
therionSacrileges.summary: Force nearby angels and demons to Materialize and spend Willpower to disobey.
therionSacrileges.effect: All Grigori in Twilight within 30 meters gain Materialized unless Resistance penalized by Potency succeeds. They cannot end it themselves; outside supernatural attempts provoke a Clash. Any Materialized being the Chorist could normally perceive in Twilight must spend Willpower to disobey her orders.

gildedInvocations.name: Crowdsourcing
gildedInvocations.summary: Turn nearby strangers into a temporary source of coordinated information and assistance.
gildedInvocations.requirement: Ways and Means: Walk from a place frequented by the desired people to the target, using polished quartz to capture and direct their energy, then leave it at the epicenter.
gildedInvocations.effect: The invocation attracts people who embody a specified emotion or group identity to an area about the size of a large city block. This is not compulsion; anyone who follows the impulse refreshes one spent Willpower. For the rest of the night, the ritualist exceptionally succeeds with three successes when searching the area for such people, including with supernatural senses such as Beast's Hackles.

gildedInvocations.name: Green Light
gildedInvocations.summary: Make urban routes and systems favor movement through the affected area.
gildedInvocations.requirement: Ways and Means: A detailed map of the area with its routes traced in pencil using a straightedge.
gildedInvocations.effect: The urban landscape subtly becomes more efficient: alleys shorten, paths smooth, and crossing lights synchronize. Rolls to travel through the area gain the Advanced Action quality: roll twice and keep the better result.

gildedInvocations.name: Cordon
gildedInvocations.summary: Turn a boundary into an occult barrier that discourages or blocks passage.
gildedInvocations.requirement: Ways and Means: Cast inside a legal building with jurisdiction over the target area and smear one Vitae on an official record connected to the subject.
gildedInvocations.effect: A subject currently within the chosen area cannot escape by mundane means; every mundane attempt automatically fails as the city produces barriers and coincidences. Supernatural escape triggers a Clash of Wills.

gildedInvocations.name: Gerrymandering
gildedInvocations.summary: Redefine which places and people count as belonging to the Invocation's area.
gildedInvocations.duration: One scene after the crowd gathers
gildedInvocations.requirement: Ways and Means: A space capable of holding the intended crowd, plus photographs or detailed plans marking every exit.
gildedInvocations.effect: Within one hour, traffic and civic infrastructure gather up to 100 people, plus another 100 per Potency, into a predefined space. Crowdsourcing may define the type of people gathered. They are not compelled to remain, but attempts to leave during the scene suffer a penalty equal to Gilded Cage dots, reduced by one per 100 people in the crowd. A mass attempt to escape may cause the Stampede Tilt.

gildedInvocations.name: Red Light
gildedInvocations.summary: Make urban routes and systems obstruct movement through the affected area.
gildedInvocations.requirement: Ways and Means: A detailed map of the area with its routes traced using a straightedge, then damaged beyond use.
gildedInvocations.effect: The urban landscape develops obstacles and inefficiencies. Rolls to navigate or travel quickly through it automatically fail, and all travel takes three times as long. The ritualist is immune while on foot or controlling her own vehicle and may grant immunity to up to Potency other people using geomantic symbols. Where Green Light overlaps, only the ritualist and her allies receive Green Light's benefit.

gildedInvocations.name: Semiotics
gildedInvocations.summary: Rewrite the social meaning of signs and landmarks within the affected area.
gildedInvocations.requirement: Ways and Means: A diagram marking the symbol's location and a visible covenant symbol created by the ritualist.
gildedInvocations.effect: The symbol carries a specific behavioral resonance. Actions within visual range that further that resonance gain 8-again. The effect may be renewed before expiration by a Mason who knows Semiotics spending one Willpower and touching the object; removing or destroying it ends the invocation.

gildedInvocations.name: Rapid Transit
gildedInvocations.summary: Create an impossibly efficient route between prepared points in the city.
gildedInvocations.duration: Until the end of the night or until used
gildedInvocations.requirement: Ways and Means: Mark the destination on a physical map using the point of a precious gemstone and keep the gem until activation.
gildedInvocations.effect: The ritualist may teleport to the marked destination as a reflexive action. She may take anything she is touching, limited to a number of Size 3+ objects or people equal to Potency, and cannot carry anything larger than herself. The gemstone remains at the departure point.

gildedInvocations.name: Rezoning
gildedInvocations.summary: Change the supernatural character and permitted uses of an urban district.
gildedInvocations.requirement: Ways and Means: A pint of blood from several residents, used to draw a detailed picture of the area.
gildedInvocations.effect: The invocation changes an area's physical and metaphysical trajectory toward prosperity or decline. Actions opposing that change automatically fail unless the actor spends Willpower; this expenditure permits the roll but grants no +3 bonus.

gildedInvocations.name: Synopticon
gildedInvocations.summary: Use the city's systems and observers as a supernatural surveillance network.
gildedInvocations.duration: One hour, plus one hour per additional Potency
gildedInvocations.requirement: Ways and Means: Give reflective objects to at least two people and spill one Vitae at each cardinal direction around their building.
gildedInvocations.effect: The reflective objects record everything their bearers see and hear while inside the building. Smearing another mirror with one Vitae provides a live feed for minutes equal to Potency; additional periods cost another Vitae. Afterward, the ritualist may drink the blood used in the Ways and Means to review each feed once in real time. Reviewing everything instantaneously causes Distracted for the rest of the scene.

gildedInvocations.name: Remise à neuf
gildedInvocations.summary: Renew a district according to the Architects' intended design.
gildedInvocations.requirement: Ways and Means: Cast within the target area over its original blueprints or government property plans.
gildedInvocations.effect: The ritualist rearranges streets, alleys, paths, rooms, or whole buildings within a large city block or a single building. She cannot merge rooms or create impossible architecture. The Storyteller sets the limits but should favor permissive interpretations. Ending the invocation restores the spent Willpower dot; if it was already repurchased, the character instead gains a Beat.

detournements.name: Contagion Principle
detournements.prerequisites: Moulding Room Initiation •; optional Beast's Hackles
detournements.summary: Implant a Vitae-soaked severed finger and track its bearer for a number of nights equal to Vitae spent.
detournements.procedure: Amputate a finger for one lethal damage, soak it in Vitae, and implant it in the subject.
detournements.outcome: Track with Wits + Empathy; a vampire subject resists with Stamina + Blood Potency.

detournements.name: Eye Behind Glass
detournements.prerequisites: Moulding Room Initiation •; optional Twilight Projection
detournements.summary: Sacrifice an eye to a camera and perceive through its feed at the cost of impaired normal vision.
detournements.procedure: Gouge out an eye for one lethal damage and install it within a camera.
detournements.outcome: Access the feed remotely; while doing so, Perception and Defense suffer −3.

detournements.name: Face of New Flesh
detournements.prerequisites: Moulding Room Initiation •; optional Lay Open the Mind
detournements.summary: Wear a mortal's surgically removed face as an undetectable identity and media focus.
detournements.procedure: Remove the vampire's face for one aggravated damage and replace it with the victim's.
detournements.outcome: The disguise defeats aura and medical scrutiny and interacts normally with Blush of Life.

detournements.name: Pleasure of Text
detournements.prerequisites: Moulding Room Initiation •; optional Spirit's Touch
detournements.summary: Consume the contents of a written or recorded medium and retain them with perfect clarity.
detournements.procedure: Coat the medium and the vampire's tongue in Vitae, then ritually consume its information.
detournements.outcome: Gain Eidetic Memory for days equal to Vitae spent and erase the original medium.

detournements.name: Soul Transplant
detournements.prerequisites: Moulding Room Initiation •; optional Uncanny Perception
detournements.summary: Implant a ritually prepared worm beneath the sternum to displace the subject's soul and expose supernatural insight.
detournements.procedure: Insert the prepared parasite through the sternum for one lethal damage.
detournements.outcome: The subject becomes Soulless while the implant remains; the vampire gains the procedure's occult insight.

coils.name: Coil of Zirnitra
coils.summary: Transforms mortal Supernatural Merits into controllable tools of the Dragon's perfected mind.

levels.name: Opening the Third Eye
levels.summary: Unlock mortal Supernatural Merits through the Coil.
levels.effect: Each Coil dot unlocks one mortal Supernatural Merit. Activation costs one additional Vitae and failed uses can become dramatic failures.

levels.name: Unleash the Mind
levels.summary: Use Supernatural Merits without normal Willpower timing restrictions.
levels.effect: Willpower spent on Supernatural Merits does not count against the per-turn Willpower limit; their printed drawbacks and dramatic failures remain.

levels.name: Embolden Potential
levels.summary: Enhance Supernatural Merits with Vitae and buy them more cheaply.
levels.effect: Physical Intensity can enhance physical expressions of Supernatural Merits; each dot costs one less Experience, minimum one, and no longer costs extra Vitae.

levels.name: The Dragon’s Breath
levels.summary: Spend Willpower for a Coil-sized bonus and avoid dramatic failures.
levels.effect: Willpower adds the Coil rating as bonus dice to a Supernatural Merit and failed uses no longer become dramatic failures.

levels.name: Ascendancy
levels.summary: Perfect Supernatural Merits beyond mortal limits.
levels.effect: Suffer one unavoidable aggravated damage to give a Supernatural Merit the rote quality; Coil dots no longer limit how many such Merits may be learned.

coils.name: Coil of Ziva
coils.summary: Transforms Humanity, detachment, banes, and the Beast's hold on the Dragon.

levels.name: Denying the Bane
levels.summary: Raise effective Humanity against most banes.
levels.effect: For banes other than fire and sunlight, add Coil dots to Humanity when determining their effects.

levels.name: Buttress the Soul
levels.summary: Spend Vitae to resist detachment.
levels.effect: Spend Vitae up to the per-turn limit and add one die per Vitae to a detachment roll.

levels.name: Enliven the Anima
levels.summary: Replace a detachment Condition with Raptured.
levels.effect: Spend Willpower after detachment to take the Raptured Condition instead of the Condition that would normally result.

levels.name: Embracing the Banes
levels.summary: Callous Humanity against many self-chosen banes.
levels.effect: Maintain a number of voluntarily adopted banes up to Willpower dots rather than the normal limit.

levels.name: Shedding the Beast’s Skin
levels.summary: Temporarily become a living mortal.
levels.effect: Spend three Willpower and five turns to shed vampiric traits for 11 − Blood Potency hours; returning takes 30 minutes and restores limited Vitae.

coils.name: Coil of Quintessence
coils.summary: Bind the Dragon to a centuries-old domain and become its dread avatar.

levels.name: Forever Mine
levels.summary: Claim a domain occupied for a century and sense forbidden Kindred predation within it.
levels.effect: The Dragon automatically senses when another Kindred feeds or kills without permission in her domain, though not the offender's identity. She may lash out with Predatory Aura at any range and recognizes the transgressor on a later face-to-face meeting. If the domain is a Touchstone, she gains one Willpower for lashing out whether she wins or loses.

levels.name: Home Turf
levels.summary: Residents must spend Willpower to resist your feeding.
levels.effect: Any denizen of the Dragon's domain must spend one Willpower to resist her feeding actions. Minor Storyteller characters without Willpower cannot resist.

levels.name: Smother
levels.summary: Suppress natural fire and contest supernatural flames in the domain.
levels.effect: Natural fires near the Dragon count one step lower for both size and heat, and combustible objects take two turns to ignite. Within her domain, she adds one to Traits resisting supernatural fire or heat and +1 to contested rolls against them. She may reflexively spend three Vitae to Clash with a supernatural fire's creator; victory extinguishes it in a diameter equal to Blood Potency meters.

levels.name: In the Motherland's Arms
levels.summary: Gain supernatural Safe Place and Haven protection while sleeping in the domain.
levels.effect: While sleeping or in torpor within the domain, the Dragon counts as having Haven and Safe Place dots equal to half Blood Potency. When she sleeps in a haven for which she owns the Merits, each is treated as one dot higher, even to six effective dots, whether or not that haven lies in her domain.

levels.name: Fingers on a Dead Pulse
levels.summary: Read residents' Vices and Conditions and receive domain-wide blood-sympathy visions.
levels.effect: By spending one Vitae while interacting with a denizen, immediately learn their Vice and Conditions reflecting shameful secrets, such as Guilty, Leveraged, or Notoriety. Once per scene, observing a denizen regain Willpower from Vice also restores one Willpower to the Dragon. Major events provoking widespread emotion may trigger blood sympathy at the Storyteller's discretion.

coils.name: Coil of the Ascendant
coils.summary: Transcends daysleep, fire, and sunlight through five cumulative tiers.

levels.name: Surmounting the Daysleep
levels.summary: Remain active by day more easily while Blush of Life is active.
levels.effect: While benefiting from Blush of Life, no roll is required to resist daysleep and remaining active by day does not inflict Lethargic.

ruleEffects.condition: Blush of Life active during daytime

levels.name: The Warm Face
levels.summary: Extend Blush of Life to a full day.
levels.effect: Blush of Life lasts 24 hours rather than one scene.

levels.name: Conquer the Red Fear
levels.summary: Fire and sunlight no longer provoke frenzy.
levels.effect: Exposure to fire or sunlight does not trigger frenzy, though damage still applies normally.

levels.name: Peace with the Flame
levels.summary: Downgrade fire damage while Blush of Life is active.
levels.effect: While Blush of Life is active, fire deals lethal rather than aggravated. Each Resilience dot can further downgrade one point of that fire damage from lethal to bashing.

ruleEffects.value: one lethal → bashing per Resilience dot

levels.name: Sun's Forgotten Kiss
levels.summary: Spend extra Vitae with Blush of Life to slow sunlight damage intervals.
levels.cost: Additional Vitae when activating Blush of Life
levels.effect: Each extra Vitae makes Blood Potency count one lower for sunlight damage interval only, minimum effective Blood Potency 1.

ruleEffects.value: 1 per extra Vitae spent with Blush of Life

coils.name: Coil of the Wyrm
coils.summary: Refines and directs the Beast through five cumulative tiers.

levels.name: Stir the Beast
levels.summary: Enter a voluntary frenzy with a declared objective.
levels.effect: Enter frenzy voluntarily and name a short goal. Escaping before the goal is met suffers a penalty; the frenzy ends when the goal is no longer pressing or possible.

levels.name: Beast's Hunger
levels.summary: Increase effective Blood Potency for senses and predatory aura while frenzying.
levels.effect: During any frenzy, add the current Coil of the Wyrm rating to Blood Potency for Kindred senses and predatory aura.

levels.name: Leash the Beast
levels.summary: Ride the Wave without Willpower and with a Coil bonus.
levels.effect: Riding the Wave no longer costs Willpower and gains the Coil of the Wyrm rating as bonus dice.

levels.name: Beast's Power
levels.summary: Surrender fully to frenzy for major physical bonuses.
levels.effect: When entering frenzy, the Dragon may forgo resistance until the Beast is sated; during that frenzy add Blood Potency to Defense, Health, and Speed.

levels.name: Eternal Frenzy
levels.summary: Remain frenzying despite lethal wounds that would normally force torpor.
levels.effect: While in frenzy, filling Health with lethal damage does not cause torpor. If frenzy ends while Health is still full of lethal, torpor begins immediately; frenzy may persist across scenes.

coils.name: Coil of the Voivode
coils.summary: Transforms Vitae addiction, blood sympathy, blood bonds, and the Embrace.

levels.name: Taste of Fealty
levels.summary: Make the Dragon's Vitae exceptionally addictive and uniquely satisfying.
levels.effect: Each point of the Dragon's Vitae counts as two for Vitae addiction; addicts can resolve blood-addiction Deprived only with Vitae from someone possessing this Coil.

levels.name: Into the Fold
levels.summary: Create blood sympathy with blood-bound subjects.
levels.effect: The Dragon and blood-bound subjects gain blood sympathy with closeness based on bond stage.

ruleEffects.value: stage 1 = four-times removed; stage 2 = three-times removed; stage 3 = twice removed

levels.name: Call to Serve
levels.summary: Accelerate a new blood bond with extra Vitae.
levels.effect: Three Vitae in one brief feeding can establish stage two; five Vitae can establish stage three. This expenditure ignores the normal Vitae-per-turn limit.

levels.name: Voivode Undisputed
levels.summary: Turn blood sympathy into resistance instead of vulnerability.
levels.effect: Blood sympathy gives no Discipline bonus against the Dragon; the Dragon adds her blood-sympathy bonus to resist blood bonds and contest predatory aura from those she has bound.

ruleEffects.value: blood-sympathy attack bonus removed against Dragon

levels.name: The Vast Dynasty
levels.summary: Replace automatic Humanity loss from Embrace with a lower breaking point.
levels.effect: Embracing no longer automatically costs Humanity. It becomes a Humanity 3 breaking point, with +1 die to avoid detachment.

ruleEffects.value: Humanity 3 breaking point; +1 die to detachment

scales.name: Beseech the Sleeping
scales.summary: Learn recent memories from sleeping mortals during Spirit Tether.
scales.procedure: Sleep through the night and spend the entire following day under Blush of Life. Repeat this procedure for every use.
scales.outcome: While using Spirit Tether, reach into a sleeping mortal's recent memories and learn anything desired about their own experiences during the previous 24 hours. The memories are colored by the mortal's emotions.

scales.name: Command the Mind
scales.summary: Spend a permanent Willpower dot to drain Willpower through Vitae.
scales.procedure: While tethered, Embrace the vampire's own body by spending one permanent Willpower dot and one Vitae, imbuing it with the spirit's ability to absorb energy.
scales.outcome: While in direct skin-to-skin contact with a sapient being, spend Vitae to drain Willpower equal to half Blood Potency, rounded down, minimum one, per Vitae spent.

scales.name: Psychic Leech
scales.summary: Drain Vitae from attuned people and places while astrally projected.
scales.procedure: Anoint at least one place or person per Blood Potency dot with the vampire's Vitae, then use Spirit Tether and revisit each point to draw the energy back. Vitae used for ghouls or blood bonds counts only if given on the same night.
scales.outcome: While tethered, Vitae glows red to the vampire's senses. Spend one Willpower to drain up to Blood Potency Vitae from a target and feed herself. A target driven into starvation must resist frenzy.

scales.name: Spirit Tether
scales.summary: Gain astral projection through a regimen of Vitae, hallucinogens, and near-torpor.
scales.procedure: Concoct and ingest or inject a mixture of hallucinogens and Vitae, repeatedly entering a near-torpid state while keeping the mind aware.
scales.outcome: Gain the effects of Twilight Projection (Auspex •••••). While projected through Spirit Tether, the vampire may use the other Scales derived from it.

scales.name: Grafting Unholy Flesh
scales.summary: Graft a supernatural body part onto a vampire or ghoul to steal one power.
scales.procedure: On a Wyrm's Nest, remove the supernatural organ and graft it into a vampire or ghoul with one Vitae.
scales.outcome: The recipient can use the stolen power, paying one Vitae and one Willpower for each printed non-Vitae/Willpower cost; the donor loses the power while the graft survives.

scales.name: Psychic Lobotomy
scales.summary: Surgically remove a subject's Supernatural Merits while hardening the damaged mind.
scales.procedure: Remove and preserve part of the subject's brain through ritual surgery.
scales.outcome: The subject loses a Mental or Social dot and all Supernatural Merits, but adds the Dragon's Zirnitra rating to resist mental probing or influence until the aggravated injury regenerates.

scales.name: Bleed the Sin
scales.summary: Drain a subject so the next increase of Humanity or Integrity costs less.
scales.procedure: Keep the subject drained of blood for ten minutes while conducting the Scale.
scales.outcome: The subject receives a one-time Experience discount on the next dot of Humanity or another Integrity trait equal to the Dragon's Ziva rating.

scales.name: Siphon the Soul
scales.summary: Nearly diablerize a vampire to steal one dot of Humanity.
scales.procedure: Drain the restrained vampire in a controlled imitation of diablerie and complete the prescribed contest.
scales.outcome: Success steals one Humanity dot from that subject once, leaves the victim in torpor, and forces the Dragon to face a Humanity 1 breaking point and spiritual taint.

scales.name: Cold of the Grave
scales.summary: Share Smother with every vampire who calls the domain home.
scales.procedure: Collect at least five Vitae from one vampire per large neighborhood or district. Mix it with the Dragon's entire full Vitae pool and ground bones and rotten flesh from at least one corpse exhumed from every cemetery in the domain. Build a pyre near the domain's geographic center and ritually extinguish it with the mixture.
scales.outcome: For one year, every vampire who calls the domain home benefits from Smother while within its borders.

scales.name: Day-Wake Conditioning
scales.summary: Reverse a vampire subject's sleep cycle while the conditioning is maintained.
scales.procedure: Force a vampire to resist daysleep until resistance falls to a chance die, then allow sleep only at dusk in a brightly lit chamber.
scales.outcome: The subject wakes at dawn and sleeps at night indefinitely while continuing to sleep in bright light each night; more than two consecutive nights without doing so ends the effect.

scales.name: Epidermal Shielding Bath
scales.summary: Temporarily improve a Kindred subject's effective Humanity against sunlight.
scales.procedure: Submerge a Kindred in an alchemical bath for one hour while Vitae is bled into the mixture.
scales.outcome: For 24 hours, each Vitae invested increases effective Humanity by one for sunlight damage only.

scales.name: Flesh Graft Treatment
scales.summary: Temporarily make grievous wounds easier to heal.
scales.procedure: Prepare mortal skin grafts in fresh human blood, bind them over damaged areas, and inject very fresh human blood.
scales.outcome: Kindred can heal aggravated damage with Vitae as though it were lethal. Mortals can heal lethal with Vitae supplied in the treatment; this may create a blood bond/ghoul.

scales.name: Augmented Vitae Draught
scales.summary: Bottle a Physical Intensity augmentation for a mortal.
scales.procedure: Use sterilized needles and tubing, then trigger Physical Intensity so the spent Vitae drains into a sealed vessel.
scales.outcome: The stored Vitae remains potent for Blood Potency hours. A mortal drinking it gains the physical augmentation for a scene, then takes bashing damage equal to twice the Vitae invested and develops blood addiction.

scales.name: Kindred Sense Endowment
scales.summary: Grant a mortal temporary vampire-like blood senses.
scales.procedure: Prepare and distill a blood-and-bone mixture, apply it to the subject's eyes and nose, and have the subject ingest the remainder.
scales.outcome: For about 24 hours the mortal senses blood as though Blood Potency 2 and develops a dangerous hunger for human blood.

scales.name: Blood Cleansing Ritual
scales.summary: Attempt to remove an existing blood bond.
scales.procedure: Prepare an animal-blood and viscera wash mixed with several Vitae and repeatedly force it through the restrained subject's nose and mouth.
scales.outcome: For each Vitae invested, roll Dragon Blood Potency minus the bond creator's Blood Potency; any success permanently removes the bond. The Dragon's Vitae in the wash does not create a new bond.

scales.name: Surgical Heart Removal
scales.summary: Remove a Kindred subject's heart through a reversible but dangerous operation.
scales.procedure: Perform a six-hour surgery: extended Intelligence + Medicine, 10 successes, one-hour interval. Reversal uses the same roll.
scales.outcome: On success the subject cannot be staked and cannot gain Vitae from feeding, but can still spend stored Vitae or gain it from blood sorcery. Destroying the body eventually regenerates it from the heart; destroying the heart kills the subject.

rollResults.dramaticFailure: The heart is destroyed; the subject frenzies and reaches Final Death at scene end.
rollResults.failure: The subject falls into torpor as if staked until the heart is restored.
rollResults.success: Heart removal succeeds with the listed consequences.
rollResults.exceptionalSuccess: Normal extended-action exceptional-success benefit only.

scales.name: Fealty's Reward
scales.summary: Create an unusually enduring ghoul from a stage-three bound mortal.
scales.procedure: Drain a stage-three blood-bound mortal to the last Health box, collect the Dragon's gained Vitae, have the subject drink it, then rest 48 hours.
scales.outcome: The subject becomes a ghoul for one year rather than one month, renewable only by the Dragon. If the state expires, the ghoul dies and later rises as a draugr.

scales.name: Mass Embrace
scales.summary: Embrace a prepared group through one collective procedure.
scales.procedure: Gather mortals in a basin-like space, bleed out the Dragon's Vitae, drain the subjects into the pool, drink from the pooled blood, and inject it into the corpses.
scales.outcome: Subjects rise at Blood Potency 1 with one Vitae. Each makes a chance die: success = control, failure = immediate frenzy, dramatic failure = draugr. The Dragon loses Humanity as with an ordinary Embrace.

scales.name: Sanguinary Invigoration
scales.summary: Prepare a living vessel so much higher-Blood-Potency vampires can feed from it.
scales.procedure: Mix one extracted Vitae with arcane ingredients and inject the fresh preparation into a living human or animal within ten minutes.
scales.outcome: For one week, the Dragon treats Blood Potency as four lower when checking whether she can feed from the subject and four higher for smelling the subject's blood. The subject is not blood-bound or addicted by the injection itself.
